messages.text: TRN-017 Pori: swapped the optics on 1/1/2 this morning. Port is up, rx -4.2 dBm, no alarms, but in/out is flat zero for 40 min now
Gen1 box, right? Same thing as Kemi last year. Shut / no shut the port, leave the module alone and don't reload the chassis
FYI for anyone going to Kajaani (TRN-015): the private road has a boom with a padlock. Key is at the K-Market service desk in town, ask for the Elisa key.
The landowner is switching to a code lock on 1 December. After that no key, the code comes from site security (Tiina Rantanen).
Heads up: the road to the Sodankylä site (TRN-021) is closed for bridge repair until 20 November. Use the northern detour via the Vuotso road, adds about 40 min.
yes, after the TRN-017 change review
👍 I'm off Friday btw, Emilia covers the on-call
TRN-010 in Lahti shows CRC errors on 1/1/4. Maybe the SFP is bad?
Careful with TRN-019 in Lappeenranta. It is from the 2018 batch: the port bounce does not clear the zero-traffic state there, you have to reseat the line card.
I don't agree, the bounce worked on 019 when we had this in spring. Reseating the card takes the whole node down.
KMAX-4K radio on ACC-007 hanging again, just power-cycle it, it always comes back.
Correction to what I said in September: since the October firmware a power-cycle wipes the config on the KMAX-4K. Export the config first, then restart.
From Monday the Pori transport room (TRN-017) needs an access badge, the old keys no longer work. Badges from the facilities desk.

messages.subject: TRN-010 zero traffic after optics swap
messages.text:
Hi Erkki,

FYI: TRN-010 in Lahti (a TNC-2X, not one of the old Gen1 units) did exactly the Kemi thing yesterday after an optics swap on 1/1/1: up, light OK, no traffic. A shut/no shut fixed it.

So it is not only the old units.

Aino
